authority: Article XIX — pre-registration of all numerical parameters BEFORE C3-X-R1 experiment runs.
constitutional_basis: Article IV — no fallback epistemology (cannot use weak Baseline B)
Article VII — never weaken the verifier to rescue a claim
Article XIX — never optimize for the gate
Article XXIX — separate implementation from mechanism
purpose: Round 156 specified the C3-X-R1 experiment DESIGN (two baselines: ThecaFlex open-loop + Bayesian adaptive TDM; cohort stratification; primary endpoint = concentration stability in therapeutic window). Round 157 specifies the NUMERICAL PARAMETERS. These are now FROZEN. Any change requires V2 pre-registration with explicit rationale.

model_drug_intrathecal_baclofen.rationale: Intrathecal baclofen is chosen because (a) PK is well-published allowing Baseline B calibration, (b) therapeutic window is well-established, (c) overdose is clinically significant (coma, respiratory depression), (d) underdosing is clinically significant (spasticity breakthrough), (e) FDA-approved for intrathecal delivery via implanted pump (SynchroMed, similar to ThecaFlex platform).
model_drug_intrathecal_baclofen.therapeutic_window_source: Published intrathecal baclofen therapeutic range (multiple references — Penn et al., 1995; Albright et al., 2007)
model_drug_intrathecal_baclofen.toxicity_threshold_source: Published intrathecal baclofen toxicity case reports
model_drug_intrathecal_baclofen.subtherapeutic_threshold_source: Same as therapeutic window lower bound

dose_protocol.source: ThecaFlex DRx published dosing protocols (Biogen clinical study materials; intrathecal baclofen standard of care)

Baseline_A_ThecaFlex_open_loop_parameter.delivery_lag_source: Catheter dead-volume estimate (typical intrathecal catheter dead volume ~0.5 mL / flow rate ~0.04 mL/min = 12.5 min; using midpoint 7.5 min for conservative baseline)
Baseline_A_ThecaFlex_open_loop_parameter.no_feedback_rationale: Baseline A is open-loop by definition. Dose is fixed at initial value for the entire dosing horizon.

Baseline_B_Bayesian_adaptive_TDM_paramet.PK_model: Two-compartment mammillary model (central CSF compartment + peripheral tissue compartment)

central_volume_Vc_L.source: Published intrathecal baclofen PK (Penn et al. 1995; Mueller et al. 2003)

PK_parameters.absorption_rate_ka_per_h: N/A — direct intrathecal infusion, no absorption

Bayesian_prior.prior_distribution: Log-normal with population mean = published PK parameters above, variance = 30% CV (coefficient of variation)
Bayesian_prior.prior_source: Standard Bayesian TDM prior (Beal et al. NONMEM methodology)

Bayesian_update.measurement_noise_source: Typical CSF drug concentration assay CV
Bayesian_update.update_method: MAP (maximum a posteriori) estimation using Kalman filter on linearized PK model
Bayesian_update.posterior_used_for: Update dose recommendation to maintain trough concentration in therapeutic window

dose_adjustment_algorithm.if_trough_below_therapeutic_window: Increase dose by 20% (subject to max daily dose constraint)
dose_adjustment_algorithm.if_trough_above_therapeutic_window: Decrease dose by 20% (subject to min effective dose constraint)
dose_adjustment_algorithm.max_daily_dose_source: FDA label for intrathecal baclofen (Lioresal Intrathecal)

CSF_state_estimator.type: Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) on continuous CSF drug concentration signal
CSF_state_estimator.process_noise_Q: Diagonal covariance with 10% of state variance on diagonal
CSF_state_estimator.computational_cost: Within budget: ~0.5 FLOP/s avg over 1-hour windows

adaptive_dosing_controller.type: MPC (Model Predictive Control) with 4-hour prediction horizon
adaptive_dosing_controller.objective_function: minimize integral of (concentration - target)^2 + lambda * dose_change^2
adaptive_dosing_controller.lambda_rationale: Penalizes aggressive dose changes to avoid oscillation; tuned on training cohort
constraints: max_dose_frequency_per_day = 8 (more frequent than Baseline A's 4/day because C3-X uses continuous feedback)

virtual_cohort_parameters.dosing_horizon_rationale: 3 months — sufficient to capture steady-state PK behavior and patient-specific optimization

physiological_perturbations.CSF_flow_variation: Posture-dependent (supine 0.5 mL/min, upright 0.3 mL/min) + diurnal (15% variation)
physiological_perturbations.dose_constraints: max 1 mg/kg per dose, max 4 doses per day (Baseline A); max 8 doses per day (C3-X), max daily dose 0.8 mg/kg
physiological_perturbations.toxicity_constraints: Concentration > 500 ng/mL = overdose alert; concentration > 1000 ng/mL = severe overdose
physiological_perturbations.model_uncertainty: PK parameters with 20% coefficient of variation

primary_endpoint_parameters.mathematical_definition: Fraction of patient-time that CSF drug concentration is within [100, 400] ng/mL
primary_endpoint_parameters.secondary_metric_CV: Coefficient of variation of CSF drug concentration over the dosing horizon
primary_endpoint_parameters.operating_window: Steady state only (first 14 days excluded from analysis to allow PK equilibration)

secondary_endpoints.overdosing_events: Count of patient-time where concentration > 500 ng/mL
secondary_endpoints.underdosing_events: Count of patient-time where concentration < 100 ng/mL
secondary_endpoints.time_to_therapeutic_window_days: Days from dosing start to first sustained (24h) period in therapeutic window
secondary_endpoints.patient_specific_optimization_benefit: Per-patient improvement in fraction-in-window vs population-optimal fixed dose

statistical_analysis_plan.primary_analysis: Per-arm fraction-in-window with 95% CI via bootstrap (n=1000)
statistical_analysis_plan.secondary_analysis: Per-arm CV, overdosing events, underdosing events, time-to-therapeutic-window with 95% CI
statistical_analysis_plan.multiple_testing_correction: Bonferroni across 2 baselines × 4 endpoints = 8 comparisons, adjusted alpha = 0.00625
statistical_analysis_plan.per_protocol_vs_intent_to_treat: Per-protocol only (no dropouts in virtual cohort)

computational_budget.C3_X_exception: C3-X may use up to 1 FLOP/s avg IF continuous-feedback computation is clinically practical (does not require impractical battery/hardware)
computational_budget.budget_monitoring: Computational cost logged per arm. Exceeding budget is a CI failure.

FROZEN_artifacts_chain.preregistration_THIS_FILE: C3_X_R1_PREREGISTRATION_V1.json (this file, hash to be recorded after write)

what_is_FORBIDDEN_after_results_are_know: Changing PK parameters, dose protocols, controller gains, or any other parameter (Article XIX)
Re-running with different random seeds and reporting only the best (Article XIX)
Excluding specific patient phenotypes from the analysis (Article XXXII)
Adding post-hoc secondary endpoints and presenting them as primary (Article XXVIII)
Weakening Baseline B (e.g., using poorer PK parameters, less frequent sampling, weaker Bayesian update) to make C3-X look better (Article IV — no fallback epistemology)

adversarial_self_attack.attack_1_weak_Baseline_B: Coder sees C3-X barely beats Baseline A but loses to Baseline B. Coder is tempted to weaken Baseline B (e.g., reduce sampling frequency from weekly to monthly, or use poorer PK parameters). COUNTER: Baseline B parameters are frozen in THIS file. Any change requires V2 pre-registration with explicit rationale BEFORE re-running. Article IV violation if attempted.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_2_unfair_C3_X_data: Coder gives C3-X additional sensor data (e.g., plasma drug concentration) that baselines do not have. COUNTER: measurement stream is specified — C3-X gets continuous CSF drug concentration only, same signal Baseline B samples weekly. No additional sensors. Article XIX.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_3_high_dose: Coder lets C3-X exceed dose constraints to win. COUNTER: dose constraints are frozen (max daily 0.8 mg/kg). C3-X cannot win by exceeding the labeled dose.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_4_cherry_picked_phenotype: Coder excludes slow metabolizers where C3-X may have less advantage. COUNTER: cohort stratification is frozen. All 200 patients must be included.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_5_metric_gaming: Coder reports CV alone without overdosing events. COUNTER: BOTH CV and overdosing events are pre-registered as required endpoints. Both must achieve WIN threshold.
adversarial_self_attack.attack_6_silent_promotion: Coder claims 'C3-X beats ThecaFlex' when it actually only beats our open-loop reproduction (Baseline A). COUNTER: explicit naming 'Baseline A (ThecaFlex-style open-loop)' and 'Baseline B (Bayesian adaptive TDM)'. Article XXVIII.

honest_disclosure.what_is_strong: Both baselines have pre-registered parameters from published literature. C3-X must beat BOTH. No strawman.
what_is_still_weak: The baclofen PK parameters are population averages; individual patient variability is modeled with 20-30% CV but real patient variability may be higher.
The ThecaFlex-specific PK data is not publicly available; we use intrathecal baclofen standard-of-care as a proxy.
The C3-X MPC controller has a lambda parameter (dose penalty) tuned on training cohort — this tuning happens BEFORE test cohort results are known, but is still a design choice.
The disease model is steady-state PK; we do not model disease progression (spasticity worsening or improvement).
honest_disclosure.what_we_are_NOT_claiming: We are NOT claiming these parameters are correct. We are claiming they are FROZEN. The experiment will produce whatever result it produces.
